title: Morgan and Townsend Brown's conversation about a time travel list

tellings.quote: Well, that recalls a conversation between Morgan and Townsend Brown, where Morgan's in his office and Townsend Brown said, "What if What if we had the ability to time travel? You know, I believe we're going to be able to do it in our lifetime."

plain: The inventor Thomas Townsend Brown, whom Michels presents as a scientist who worked with the CIA and built UFO-like craft, is said to have once sat in the office of a man Michels names only as Morgan and asked, "What if we had the ability to time travel?", adding that he believed "we're going to be able to do it in our lifetime." Michels tells the exchange himself, without naming a source. If true, it would show Brown's circle seriously thinking about time travel as a near-term possibility.
